data.one_liner: Convert supported URIs, including Android content URIs, into local File objects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin to convert URI strings into dart:io File instances. It supports Android content:// URIs by copying them to a temporary file in the app directory, alongside standard URIs handled by File.fromUri.
use_when: You need to handle Android content:// URIs from intents or deep links and convert them to readable files.
You are working with deep linking packages like uni_links and need to process incoming URI strings as files.
avoid_when: You pass Uri objects converted via uri.toString(), which transforms strings to lowercase and breaks functionality.
You only need standard path manipulation without resolving custom URI schemas.
strengths: Simplifies handling of Android content URIs in Flutter.
Supports standard URIs handled natively by File.fromUri.
weaknesses: Requires passing raw URI strings rather than standard Uri objects due to lowercase conversion issues.
Limited to Android and iOS platforms.
